maria-l: Staging perf alert: decode p95 jumped ~2.5x after today's merge (commit d4e3f2). Repro locally on gpu-rt-12. Anyone picking this up? :frowning:

deploy-bot: CI perf test 'decode-p95' failed on canary: baseline 115ms -> 275ms (regression threshold exceeded)

kevinw: I can bisect, starting with range ...d4e3f2..HEAD

sasha: Logs look like an alloc/memcpy waterfall during small-batch decode. KV cache warmup triggers extra memcpy. Posting perftrace.

maria-l: ```
perftrace summary:
- smallseq (len 16): before 110ms, after 280ms
- memcpy peaks align with KV evict path and scheduler handoff
flame: https://internal/fg/abc123
```

ryan: Can you paste the minimal repro? I have a repro script I can run on staging.

maria-l: ```
python tools/repro_decode.py --model redwood-14b --seq 16 --batch 4 --prefetch=on
# reproduces ~270ms p95 on nV100-staging
```

kevinw: Bisect update: culprit narrowed to commit d4e3f2 — change in fused-attn scheduler/graft that rearranges micro-batches. Reverting locally drops p95 back to ~120ms.

sasha: Pattern: when micro-batch boundaries align with kv_chunk_size we do an extra memcpy into a transient buffer, causing alloc waterfall and stalls. Probable fix: reuse existing buffer or avoid transient memcpy for aligned cases.

maria-l: This is a rollout blocker for canary. Please hold the release. @ops

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for release/2025-03-19 per request by maria-l.

kevinw: I'll open PR with a revert + add microbench reproducer and a regression test. Assigning to @sasha for patch.

sasha: I'll add histogram assertion for memcpy counts in scheduler and a targeted unit test to catch this.

maria-l: Thanks — once PR merged, we'll re-run canary and unpause. Keep updates brief here.
